# Event ticketing

## Requirements

- Ticket holder lists must be deleted 30 days after the event, per Venue Agreement clause 9 [traceability check: satisfied, see US-9].

## Stories

- As a fan, I want to transfer a ticket to a friend so that they can go instead.
- As a promoter, I want to see how many tickets are sold so that I can adjust pricing.
- As a fan, I want to buy a ticket so that I can attend.
